mapper.select: SELECT trade_date, ts_code, stock_name, latest_price, pct_chg, board_pos, limit_style, turnover_rate, board_code, ltsz, amount FROM limit_up_pool FINAL WHERE trade_date = #{tradeDate}

SELECT lu.ts_code AS ts_code, lu.stock_name AS stock_name, lu.board_pos AS board_pos, lu.limit_style AS limit_style, lu.pct_chg AS pct_chg, lu.amount AS amount, lu.turnover_rate AS turnover_rate, COALESCE(argMax(bb.board_name, bb.board_code), lu.board_code) AS board_name FROM limit_up_pool AS lu FINAL LEFT JOIN stock_board_rel AS sbr FINAL ON splitByChar('.', lu.ts_code)[1] = sbr.ts_code AND sbr.board_type = 3 LEFT JOIN board_basic AS bb FINAL ON sbr.board_code = bb.board_code WHERE lu.trade_date = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY lu.ts_code, lu.stock_name, lu.board_pos, lu.limit_style, lu.pct_chg, lu.amount, lu.turnover_rate, lu.board_code ORDER BY lu.board_pos DESC NULLS LAST, lu.pct_chg DESC
